# DeletedEphemeralMessagesHandler

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.handlers.DeletedEphemeralMessagesHandler`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(callback: Callable, filters = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The DeletedEphemeralMessages handler class. Used to handle deleted ephemeral messages. It is intended to
be used with [`add_handler`](../methods/utilities/add_handler.md).

For a nicer way to register this handler, have a look at the
[`on_deleted_ephemeral_messages`](../decorators/on_deleted_ephemeral_messages.md) decorator.

### Parameters

- **`callback`** (`Callable`)
  Pass a function that will be called when ephemeral messages are deleted. It takes *(client,
  ephemeral_messages)* as positional arguments (look at the section below for a detailed
  description).

- **`filters`** (`Filters`)
  Pass one or more filters to allow only a subset of updates to be passed in your callback function.

Other parameters:
    client (`Client`):
        The Client itself, useful when you want to call other API methods inside the handler.

    ephemeral_messages (List of [`EphemeralMessage`](../types/messages_and_media/EphemeralMessage.md)):
        The deleted ephemeral messages; only their id and chat are known.
        The same update also reports deleted welcome messages of the chat (see
        [`WelcomeMessage`](../types/messages_and_media/WelcomeMessage.md)).
